subject: gk
question: To provide opportunities for education to his/her children between the ages of ________ is the fundamental duty of the parents according to the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 to 14**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **86th Constitutional Amendment Act** was enacted in the year **2002**.
 
• This amendment inserted **Article 21A** into the Indian Constitution, making education a fundamental right for children.
 
• According to this act, it is the **fundamental duty** of parents to provide opportunities for education to their children aged **6 to 14 years**.
 
• This age group is specifically mentioned to ensure that children receive basic elementary education.
 
• The amendment also emphasizes the state's role in ensuring free and compulsory education for children in this age group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 21A**__

 __
 
• **Article 21A** was introduced by the **86th Amendment** to make education a fundamental right.
 
• This article mandates the state to provide free and compulsory education to all children between the ages of **6 and 14**.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A**__
 
 
• **Article 51A** lists the fundamental duties of every citizen of India.
 
• It includes the duty of parents to provide educational opportunities to their children aged **6 to 14 years**.
